## Summary

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to reproduce

1. ...
2. ...
3. ...

## Expected behaviour

What you expected to happen.

## Actual behaviour

What actually happened. Include exact error messages, stack traces, or
screenshots of the dashboard or chat pane.

## Environment

- GarminCoach version (shown in the title bar / About): `vX.Y.Z`
- Windows version: e.g. Windows 11 23H2
- .NET runtime (only if running framework-dependent build):
  `dotnet --list-runtimes` output
- Claude model selected: Haiku 4.5 / Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.7
- Days-to-fetch setting: e.g. 7

## Additional context

Anything else worth knowing — recent NuGet updates, network conditions,
whether MFA is enabled on your Garmin account, etc.
